posts.name: Roger the Alien
posts.cooked:
Interesting question. As already mentioned, we will see "soon" what happens.

This was said at kickstarter in the newest update: 

Regarding digital release of OblivAeon, as well as mini packs, we are just now preparing to break ground on Mini-Pack 4. For those who don't follow the digital side of things, we are fast approaching the release of the next digital expansion, Villains of the Multiverse. It will be shipping "soon".

I thought Handelabra would maybe wait with the remaining variant for Kismet, Chrono Ranger and Argent Adept as filler for the OblivAeon content.

EDIT: If you have a look at the latest twitch episode with Jeremy and John (time: 9:54), you will see there is no variant implemented vor Kismet right now. I think they are only missing the opening lines and challenge modes.

I hope we will get the 3 variants along with the challenge modes for the new villains at a later point. Christopher said he still has to create the challenge modes.

posts.name: seesome
posts.cooked:
Captain Cosmic - Requital’s Incap power references OblivAeon mechanics and Extremist Sky-Scraper’s story is directly tied to the Luminary, so we probably won’t see either of those for a while.

I’m guessing that The X-treme PW set is likely to drop as it’s own mini-release between Mini-Pack 4 and Void Guard. Freedom Five will probably be it’s own mini-release too, but I’m guessing they won’t drop until the end (story coming full circle and all). Completionist Guise would also be a final var, for obvious reasons.

So that leaves:
Kismet (in the works according to above posts)
Chrono-Ranger - Best of Times (hopefully soon as he still doesn’t have a var)
Parse - Fugue State (ditto , even if she’s related to Obv)
Visionary - Unleashed
Argent Adept - Dark Dynamics/Kvothe
Ra - Setting Sun (related to pre-Obv ARG content)
And the heroes not yet in the game, of course.
